# Putters Bar & Grill

> Sports bar & grill at 503 W Verona Ave, Suite 400,
> Verona, WI 53593 (formerly The Bogey Factory). Phone (608) 497-0170.
> Hours: Mon 4-10 PM, Tue-Fri 10 AM-10 PM, weekends call ahead.
> Big-screen TVs, scratch kitchen, tap beer, full bar, patio; indoor golf simulators on site (independently operated).
> Serves southwest Dane County, WI within about a 10-mile radius, and the
> greater Madison area within 30 miles.

Every page carries a schema.org JSON-LD @graph; the business entity is
https://puttersverona.com/#business (BarOrPub).
